title: Nigeria reopens some schools in the north despite kidnap threats
summary: Schools across parts ​of northern Nigeria started reopening on January 12, after months of closure triggered ⁠by the abduction of hundreds of students in November 2025. The move follows a circular from the federal government in December 2025 saying that enhanced security measures had created a safer environment ​for students to return. FRANCE 24's Clémence…
